calls.title: Canceled: GrowthBook Demo for englishgurukul
calls.summary: Rahul Martin (customer, likely product/manager) discussed switching from Firebase to GrowthBook for experimentation due to inconsistent data, but was concerned about the lack of a Unity SDK. Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales) explained they can use the C# SDK and will share documentation. Next steps: reschedule a call for Tuesday with both teams' engineers to demo the platform and discuss BigQuery integration.
